_why_this_file_is_out_of_date: THE STALENESS IS THE FIXTURE. Do not update this to match the current
settings shape: the moment it matches, it stops testing anything.
This is a settings.json as an early build wrote it, kept so the suite has
one system WITH A PAST. Every other fixture here is created fresh in a
temp directory, which makes every claim they support a claim about a
machine with no history, and the machines that matter all have one.
Two real defects were found by a file like this and by nothing else: the
engine's shallow settings merge, where a stored section replaced a default
outright instead of filling in around it, and the client's role table
printing the literal word None because .get(key, default) does not help
when the key is present and the VALUE is null.
